subject.name: Wind Energy Engineers
subject.summary: The wind energy engineer corresponds to O*NET17-2199.10, designing underground or overhead wind farm collector systems and preparing site specifications; the tasks also include layout models, meteorological data and production estimates, turbine component specifications and testing, operating reliability and failure analysis, and construction and commissioning technical support. A specific job may lean toward resource, mechanical, electrical, or control work, and not all tasks should be treated as done in every job; development managers, operations managers, and service technicians are separated separately, and a job title does not automatically grant design signing, electrical, or work-at-height authority.
